principle: A checkpoint may be called FULL_NATIVE only at a boundary where the complete continuation parent can be saved/restored without private-state mutation, protocol modification, or stochastic prefix replay.

X1.name: AutoGen
X1.reason: Pinned AutoGen exposes Team.save_state/load_state, but upstream cautions that save_state while the team is running may be inconsistent. G1 must not infer a mid-run resumable parent from run_stream yields.
X1.repair_parent_rule: A monitor candidate arising after an uncheckpointed model decision is CHECKPOINT_BOUNDARY_BLOCKED until a separately frozen quiescent-native-boundary proof exists.

X2.name: MetaGPT
X2.reason: The frozen runner advances MetaGPT with await env.run(k=1) inside an outer loop; the external checkpoint is captured only after that await returns, before the next round begins.
X2.repair_parent_rule: The first eligible package may use the checkpoint captured after the most recent completed env.run(k=1), only if no later model decision has occurred.

X3.name: A2A
X3.reason: Nine role-service session states round-trip, but a nested role return can occur while an ancestor A2A request is still active. G1 does not call such a partial call-stack state a global resumable parent.
X3.repair_parent_rule: A candidate inside an active nested request is CHECKPOINT_BOUNDARY_BLOCKED unless the complete active continuation frame is separately proven restorable without changing A2A.

X4.name: MCP
X4.foreign_boundary: MCP protocol/server/tool/resource state is not checkpoint-mutated; only host/application state plus immutable MCP binding is saved.

X5.name: RAG
X5.foreign_boundary: RAG corpus/index/embedding/retrieval structure is reference/hash only and never restored by mutation.

X6.name: MemoryBank
X6.foreign_boundary: MemoryBank internal memory/index/strength/recall state is reference/hash only and never restored by mutation.

X7.name: LongLLMLingua
X7.foreign_boundary: LongLLMLingua model/checkpoint/compression state is reference/hash only and never restored by mutation.
